title: Value-first acquisition fix: crawler detected mailto but never extracted the email

statement: Acquisition OS routed the operator to cold phone-first work because the website crawler detected that a mailto: link existed but never extracted the address; publicEmail stayed null, so contact-strategy had no email to prefer and qualified leads fell through to cold calling. The apparent sales problem was partly a data-extraction problem. Fixed by extracting the trustworthy same-domain email and adopting it as the send route (email-first), then scheduling a warm follow-up call.

rationale: Grounded in shipped code (commit 8e70ef6): website-intelligence email extraction, send-actions warm follow-up, call-priority cold-call deprioritization. Basis for Content #001.
